scenes.title: More tools for agents, picked per role

cues.text: Symphony can give its agents more tools through MCP servers.
cues.say: Symphony can give its agents more tools through M C P servers.

cues.text: A server can search the web, read a wiki, or look up an error tracker.
An admin picks the servers, and the agent roles that get them.
When an agent starts, Symphony writes its role's servers into the agent's private config.
The agent sees each tool next to its usual tools.

scenes.title: Three transports, and the team roles

cues.text: A server uses one of three transports.
Streamable HTTP and the older SSE transport reach a remote server.
cues.say: Streamable H T T P and the older S S E transport reach a remote server.

cues.text: A stdio server is a process that runs next to the agent.
cues.say: A standard I O server is a process that runs next to the agent.

cues.text: Each server lists the agent roles that get it.
A role without servers gets no MCP tools.
cues.say: A role without servers gets no M C P tools.

cues.text: A remote server points to the sandbox gateway, not to the real URL.
cues.say: A remote server points to the sandbox gateway, not to the real U R L.

cues.text: Each agent session mints its own token, for its session and its role.
Redis keeps only a hash of it, and the agent sends it as a bearer.
The gateway checks the token, the server, and the role.
If any check fails, it answers 403, and never says which check.
cues.say: If any check fails, it answers four oh three, and never says which check.

cues.text: Otherwise it drops the agent's token, and adds the stored secret headers.
The token is revoked when the session ends, or expires after four hours.
Symphony ignores every other MCP config.
cues.say: Symphony ignores every other M C P config.

cues.text: The agent's settings turn project configs off, so a repository's own .omp/mcp.json has no effect.
cues.say: The agent's settings turn project configs off, so a repository's own M C P config has no effect.

cues.text: They also set tools.xdev to false, so a read-only role gains no write tool.
cues.say: They also set tools dot x dev to false, so a read-only role gains no write tool.

cues.text: A stdio server gets no secret headers, and no env variable that looks like a credential.
cues.say: A standard I O server gets no secret headers, and no variable that looks like a credential.

cues.text: Its command must exist in the image where the agent runs.

scenes.title: A plugin and an overlay, your agent dir untouched

cues.text: In local mode, the engines keep the host's omp agent dir, with its logins.
cues.say: In local mode, the engines keep the host's O M P agent folder, with its logins.

cues.text: Symphony writes a plugin and a settings overlay into the attempt's private dir.
cues.say: Symphony writes a plugin and a settings overlay into the attempt's private folder.

cues.text: The engine starts with --plugin-dir and --config.
cues.say: The engine starts with the plugin dir and config flags.

cues.text: The overlay wins over the host's settings, so the repository config stays off.

scenes.title: Admin › MCP in Tern, or the CLI

cues.text: Admins add servers in Tern, under Admin, MCP.
cues.say: Admins add servers in Tern, under Admin, M C P.

cues.text: Each row shows the transport, the roles, the headers and the state.
Secret headers are write-only. Tern shows their names, never their values.
Test connects through the gateway, and lists the tools or the error.
The CLI does the same, with set, headers, test and list.
cues.say: The C L I does the same, with set, headers, test and list.

cues.text: Headers come as JSON on standard input, so no value appears in an argument.
cues.say: Headers come as Jason on standard input, so no value appears in an argument.

cues.text: On Kubernetes, the gateway reads a mounted Secret.
The kubelet updates it after about a minute, so a change can take a minute to work.
cues.say: The cube-let updates it after about a minute, so a change can take a minute to work.

cues.text: A running agent keeps its servers until its session ends.
In local mode, your own ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json still loads.
cues.say: In local mode, your own M C P config, in your home O M P folder, still loads.

cues.text: Scenario 12 of the mocked certification ran MCP through the gateway.
cues.say: Scenario twelve of the mocked certification ran M C P through the gateway.

cues.text: An admin stored a mock server with two secret headers, and its test listed two tools.
The repository named its own server too. It got no request.
The coding agent called the tool, and the result reached the ticket in 16 seconds.
cues.say: The coding agent called the tool, and the result reached the ticket in sixteen seconds.

cues.text: The mock saw the stored headers, and never the agent's token.
At the end, the revoked token got 403 at the gateway.
cues.say: At the end, the revoked token got four oh three at the gateway.

cues.text: The assistant used the same route, and answered on Slack in 9 seconds.
cues.say: The assistant used the same route, and answered on Slack in nine seconds.
